description: Guarded start and local health verification for the Fieldwork Store API.

runCommand:
set -eu
exec 9>/run/fieldwork-store-api-recovery.lock
flock -n 9 || { echo STORE_API_BUSY; exit 0; }
[ "$(systemctl show fieldwork-store-api -p LoadState --value)" = loaded ] || exit 10
systemctl is-enabled --quiet fieldwork-store-api || { echo STORE_API_DISABLED; exit 0; }
service_state=$(systemctl show fieldwork-store-api -p ActiveState --value)
case "$service_state" in
  active) echo STORE_API_ACTIVE; exit 0 ;;
  inactive|failed)
    if [ "$service_state" = failed ]; then systemctl reset-failed fieldwork-store-api; fi
    timeout 12 systemctl start fieldwork-store-api
    for check_number in 1 2 3 4 5; do
      if systemctl is-active --quiet fieldwork-store-api; then
        if body=$(curl --fail --silent --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3100/health); then
          if printf '%s' "$body" | /usr/bin/node-22 -e 'let b="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>b+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{process.exit(JSON.parse(b).status==="ok"?0:1)}catch{process.exit(1)}})'; then
            echo STORE_API_STARTED; exit 0
          fi
        fi
      fi
      sleep 1
    done
    exit 11 ;;
  *) echo STORE_API_BUSY; exit 0 ;;
esac
